title: TransparencyLogCheckpoint
description: Additive/optional — v0, not frozen. A C2SP-style transparency-log checkpoint / signed note (NF-042). Emitted for every log head: origin, tree_size, root_hash (base64), timestamp, and the origin-signer signature(s) plus K-of-M witness cosignatures (NF-043). A head is 'witness-final' only with a quorum of valid witness cosignatures. Optional extension lines (sparse-Merkle map root, RFC 3161 TSA digest) are forward-compatible; unknown extensions are ignored.

origin.description: Log origin string / signed-note first line, e.g. 'novafabric.dev/log/tenant-a'.

tree_size.description: Number of leaves in the Merkle tree at this head (RFC 6962/9162).

root_hash.description: Base64-encoded Merkle tree root hash at tree_size (RFC 6962/9162 tree hashing).

timestamp.description: When this checkpoint was emitted (RFC 3339). Optional; C2SP notes are timestampless, but NovaFabric records emission time.

extension_lines.description: Optional signed-note extension lines (e.g. ADR-0090 sparse-Merkle map root, ADR-0030 RFC 3161 TSA digest). Consumers MUST ignore unknown keys (forward-compat, NF-042 req 4).

signatures.description: Origin-signer signature(s) over the note body. At least one required.

witness_cosignatures.description: C2SP tlog-witness cosignatures (NF-043). A head is witness-final only with a K-of-M quorum of distinct valid witness signature lines (default 2-of-3).

witness_quorum.description: Configured K-of-M witness quorum this checkpoint must satisfy to be witness-final.

extensions.description: Vendor extensions. Keys must be reverse-DNS-prefixed.

value.description: Extension value (opaque; hex or base64 per the key's convention).

key_name.description: Signed-note key name, e.g. 'novafabric-witness-1' or the origin signer name.

alg.description: Signature algorithm. C2SP signed notes use Ed25519.

sig.description: Base64-encoded signature over the signed-note body.

k.description: Minimum number of valid distinct witness cosignatures required (default 2).

x-novafabric.governed_by: NF-042 (checkpoint / signed note); part of NF-041/043/044/045/047/048/050 transparency log
x-novafabric.adr: ADR-0097 (verifiable, witness-cosigned transparency log); extends ADR-0041 NovaSeal Merkle log; relates to ADR-0089, ADR-0090, ADR-0030, ADR-0031, ADR-0024
x-novafabric.wire_form:
C2SP signed note: body = origin
tree_size
base64(root_hash)
[extension lines]; blank line; one '— <keyname> <base64 sig>' per signature/cosignature
